name: Algebraic Graph Obfuscation
description: Translates the independent set condition into a quadratic form over a binary vector. The adjacency matrix is constructed with 1s on the diagonal and 1s for edges. The condition x^T M x = k for a binary vector of sum k forces all cross-terms to be 0, which is mathematically equivalent to an independent set. This forces the model to algebraically deduce the equivalence rather than relying on graph-based pattern matching.
